rationale: The original thesis relied on support holding at the 5-minute 9-EMA ($39.19) and prior day's high ($39.14), both of which have cleanly failed over five consecutive lower-closing 1-minute candles since entry. With price now at $38.96—just above the $38.90 hard stop—closing now cuts the loss early as the pullback has broken down toward session VWAP ($38.79) rather than bouncing. However, flipping short directly into rising session VWAP and a strong broader market (SPY +0.63%) on a 4.05x relative volume gap-up day carries poor risk-reward.
